mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment above 4.5% triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 5 trading days due to heightened inflation expectations and reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not rise above 4.5% in the next month or 5-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Opposite movements in GDP demand (GDPC1) and monetary policy (FEDFUNDS)—specifically, rising demand alongside falling rates—signal expansionary conditions, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Proxies do not move in opposite directions or 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent high supply growth (INDPRO >5% monthly) and ultra-low rates (FEDFUNDS <3%) during a late-cycle expansion create favorable investment conditions, yielding positive 20-day returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth ≤5% or FEDFUNDS ≥3% or 20-day returns not positive.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) coupled with strong GDP demand (GDPC1) creates an overheating economy, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns as market adjusts to potential inflation.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises while GDPC1 also rises
failure_condition: Proxies do not both rise or 5-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Extreme monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS <2%) combined with rising CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL >1% monthly) triggers negative 20-day returns as investors anticipate higher interest rates.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with inflation concerns
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS ≥2% or CPIAUCSL ≤1% monthly or 20-day returns not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in supply output (INDPRO <100) below historical levels signals contraction, resulting in negative 5-day S&P 500 returns due to reduced growth prospects.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not fall below 100 or 5-day returns are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained upward trend in supply growth (INDPRO) over 6 months indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show sustained upward trend or 60-day returns are not positive.
